title: A final adjudicative record within scope refutes the allegation alone
spec_ref: SPEC 7.3, single-record exception at R2 and R3, decision D-013
note: This is the only route by which a false allegation about a living party reaches refuted under symmetrical thresholds. Withholding the exception would make symmetry operate against the accused.

claim.wording: Meridian Instruments Inc. knowingly falsified calibration records for the RX-9 sensor between 2023 and 2025.

assertions.quote: Plaintiff alleges that defendant knowingly falsified calibration records
The court finds no evidence that calibration records were falsified
assertions.scope: civil matters within the Northern District
